title: Stripe's payment form opens on the bank account
assertion: The Payment Element's options list `us_bank_account` first and `card` second, from the shared order; tabs with the first open; Apple Pay, Google Pay and Link off; the start button reads "Add a bank account (ACH) or card" with nothing on file and "Replace it with a bank account (ACH) or card" with a method on file; a confirmed setup shows the saved notice, and one waiting on a micro-deposit shows the verification notice with Stripe's link
noFileReason: The Payment Element’s options and the confirmation’s notices are built from values the test passes in memory; Stripe’s form never renders; no file.
